meta.title: Virtual tours of Uzbekistan
meta.description: Look around Tashkent and the mountains near it in full 360°, walk through Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva in photo tours, then plan the real trip with our travel team.
meta.tourDescription: Look around {name} in an interactive tour, see the highlights on a map and plan your trip.

hub.title: Step into Uzbekistan before you fly
hub.lead: Turn a full 360° on a Tashkent museum square and on a ridge of the western Tian Shan, then stroll through Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva in immersive photo tours. When a place wins your heart, we turn it into a real trip.
hub.listLead: 360° tours are built from full-sphere panoramas; photo tours guide you through the best views of each city.
hub.howTitle: From a virtual walk to a real journey
hub.how1Text: Drag, swipe or use the arrow keys to turn 360°. Tap the gold points for the story of each place.
hub.how2Text: See where every scene is on the map and what else is nearby, with the best season to go.
hub.how3Text: Send the city to the trip builder or ask the AI guide — our travel manager confirms every detail.

detail.ctaText: Turn this walk into a real trip: we match hotels, guides and transport to your dates and budget.

preview.text: Turn 360° in Tashkent and the mountains near the capital, then walk through Samarkand and Bukhara in immersive photo tours — before you book a single flight.
